claims.text: Usual therapeutic dose: up to 1 mg daily (adults and children); resistant cases may need more.
claims.quote: The usual therapeutic dosage in adults and children (regardless of age) is up to 1 mg daily. Resistant cases may require larger doses.
Folic acid, USP is contraindicated in patients who have shown previous intolerance to the drug.

claims.text: Folic acid alone is improper therapy for pernicious anemia/B12-deficient megaloblastic anemia:
claims.quote: Administration of folic acid alone is improper therapy for pernicious anemia and other megaloblastic anemias in which vitamin B12 is deficient.

claims.text: doses > 0.1 mg/day can mask pernicious anemia (blood counts recover while neurologic damage progresses).
claims.quote: Folic acid in doses above 0.1 mg daily may obscure pernicious anemia in that hematologic remission can occur while neurologic manifestations remain progressive.
